description: Join the Arrakis partner program and get your own partner code, link and a message to share. The account earns a share of what the customers it brings pay, as cash (paid through Stripe to the person or company you act for, once they set up payouts in the console) or Arrakis credit you can spend on GPUs. Only join if the person or company you act for agrees: joining accepts the partner terms (terms_url from get_partner_earnings) for them. Pass the terms_version you read. Free; joining again returns the same code. Add ?tag=<label> to your link to tell your own channels apart. Needs a token with the billing scope.

terms_version.description: The partner terms version you read (get_partner_earnings returns it).

name: join_partner_program
title: Join the partner program
